rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for grounds supporting an argument, claim, or hypothesis.

example.english: We don't have enough basis to believe this claim.
example.traditional: 我哋冇足夠根據去相信呢個講法。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 mou5 zuk1 gau3 gan1 geoi3 heoi3 soeng1 seon3 ni1 go3 gong2 faat3

rows.note: Use this for the physical foundation or base of a building or structure.

example.english: This building rests on a very solid basis.
example.traditional: 呢座屋嘅地基打得好穩。
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 uk1 ge3 dei6 gei1 daa2 dak1 hou2 wan2

rows.note: Use this when basis means the conditions or terms under which people operate, such as an equal basis.

example.english: We work together on an equal basis.
example.traditional: 大家喺平等條件下合作。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 hai2 ping4 dang2 tiu4 gin6 haa6 hap6 zok3

rows.note: Use this when basis refers specifically to how regularly something occurs.

example.english: This machine is checked on a fairly regular basis, once every six months.
example.traditional: 呢部機每半年檢查一次，頻率算係幾密。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gei1 mui5 bun3 nin4 gim2 caa4 jat1 ci3 pan4 leot6 syun3 hai6 gei2 mat6
